Almanya'da eğitim alabilmek için genelli: In order to study in Germany, knowledge of German at B2 or C1 level is generally required. However, some universities also offer programs in English. For English programs, a TOEFL or IELTS certificate is sufficient.
Almanya'da üniversite eğitimi ücretli mi: Is university education paid in Germany?
Almanya'daki devlet üniversitelerinde li: Undergraduate and graduate education at public universities in Germany is mostly free. Only the periodic contribution (approximately 200-400 Euros) is paid. Transportation card and other student services are provided with this contribution. Private universities and some MBA programs are fee-based.
Almanya'da eğitim sürecim ne kadar sürer: How long will my education process take in Germany?
Almanya'daki başvuru ve kabul süreçleri: Application and admission processes in Germany can often take several months. The process may vary depending on the university to which the application is made and the application density. Therefore, it is recommended that you make your applications at least 3-6 months before the start of the semester.
Almanya'da çalışma izni var mı?: Is there a work permit in Germany?
Evet, Almanya'da eğitim alırken belirli: Yes, there are opportunities to work part-time while studying in Germany under certain conditions. You may have various legal rights regarding job search and work permits after graduation.
Başvuru için hangi belgeler gereklidir?: What documents are required for application?
Başvuru için genellikle şu belgeler gere: The following documents are generally required for application: Diploma and transcript, motivation letter, CV, language proficiency certificate (German or English) and reference letters for some programmes. Additional tests such as GRE/GMAT may also be required for some departments.
Üniversite seçimi akademik hedeflerinize: Choosing a university depends on your academic goals, department and budget. Universities such as TU München, Heidelberg, LMU München, Humboldt are at the top of the world rankings. However, the best university for each student may be different. Our consultants can offer you specific university recommendations.
Almanya'da barınma nasıl sağlanır?: How to get housing in Germany?
Almanya'da öğrenciler genellikle öğrenci: In Germany, students usually stay in student dormitories (Studentenwohnheim), WG (shared flats) or private apartments. Student dormitories are the most economical option (250-400 Euro/month). WGs, on the other hand, offer a social environment. It is important to apply for housing early.
Almanya'daki üniversitelere başvurular g: Applications to universities in Germany are generally made for two semesters: May to July for the Winter semester (October start), November to January for the Summer semester (April start). However, application dates may differ for each program. Applying early increases your chances.
Mezuniyet sonrası Almanya'da kalabilir m: Can I stay in Germany after graduation?
Evet! Almanya, mezuniyet sonrası iş aram: Yes! Germany offers advantageous opportunities to students regarding job search and work permits after graduation. During this period, you can find a position suitable for your business and apply for long-term work and residence rights.
